article.title: The U.S. government is going after a Michigan labor union over its Palestine activism
article.author: Adi Saleem and Yarden Azoulay Katz
article.content: The U.S. government is criminalizing a campus labor union at the University of Michigan for supporting Palestine. We are calling on fellow labor organizers to resist this dangerous act of repression
